plannedBriefs.title: Compare two accounts of the work
plannedBriefs.purpose: Learn how to find the actual bottleneck while respecting the people doing the work.
plannedBriefs.savedResult: Evidence notes, neutral follow-up questions and a revised process map.

plannedBriefs.title: Choose and validate one opportunity
plannedBriefs.purpose: Make a provisional recommendation and improve it with client knowledge.
plannedBriefs.savedResult: A ranked shortlist and an agreed or still-provisional pilot choice.

plannedBriefs.title: Explain value without inflating it
plannedBriefs.purpose: Connect improvements to benefits the client can actually realise.
plannedBriefs.savedResult: A capacity estimate and a separately justified financial case.

plannedBriefs.title: Help the client make one decision
plannedBriefs.purpose: Explain the evidence and a proportionate next step clearly.

plannedBriefs.title: Define the assessment and delivery partnership
plannedBriefs.purpose: Understand how to sell useful investigation and coordinate implementation within demonstrated capability.
plannedBriefs.savedResult: A bounded offer and responsibility/handover note.

readings.label: Jon Jones — What Is AI Automation?
readings.question: Who decides the next step? Which part needs a model, and which can use a rule?

readings.label: Jon Jones — Failure-alert account
readings.question: What evidence would show that the intended result happened? Who or what notices if the worker stops?

readings.label: Jon Jones — AI Automation Consultant
readings.question: Who will operate, change and repair the work after delivery?

readings.label: Jon Jones — Human involvement and the approval queue
readings.question: What counts as approval? Draw the point where a required decision actually stops an action. Keep ordinary notifications separate.

readings.label: Jon Jones — Three purchasing arrangements
readings.question: What exactly is the client buying? Compare who operates the system, pays its ongoing costs, and can take over or exit. Do not adopt the article's prices as a local benchmark.

readings.label: Jon Jones — Build-versus-hire and a paid trial
readings.question: What would make a small paid build convincing? Describe a finished result another person can inspect.

readings.label: Jon Jones — A producer/worker learning account
readings.question: How do I learn the technical vocabulary? Explain the observed problem, the proposed pattern, and the test that would demonstrate improvement.

readings.label: Jon Jones — AI and consulting
readings.question: How could I package a repeatable deliverable? Define one outcome, scope, client contribution and turnaround.

readings.label: Andrew Dunn — AI consulting course (video)
readings.question: After a relevant part: what does the owner need; what does the operator actually do; which assumption could change the preferred option; or what decision should the client make next? Do not import its fee minimums or revenue forecasts as benchmarks.
